selection_result: Frozen candidate passes: positive context reduction, unchanged admission, and no additional loss of provisionally useful evidence on development and held-out cases.
runtime_default: disabled; opt-in only; no application environment or deployment changes
human_label_validation: pending; untouched score-hidden templates remain private
evaluation_scope: Fixed queries through actual local embedding, role-filtered dense search, reranker, and relevance gate. Paired pruning on identical frozen candidates; no classifier, rewriter, retry, cache, generation or answer-quality evaluation.
label_provenance: assistant_provisional; 280 reviewed query-candidate pairs across development and held-out, not human or independent gold labels

known_gate_limitation.result: Direct evidence was retrieved but rejected on the first pass by the existing gate, with and without pruning. Retry was not evaluated.

interpretation_limits: Character reduction is not a measured token, monetary-cost or latency reduction.
Retention is relative to baseline-admitted evidence, not all relevant corpus evidence: held-out candidate-pool recall is unchanged at 26/29, not 100%.
The 14 held-out queries use the same corpus; this is not document-disjoint generalization evidence.
No known-negative answerability labels were established, so gate specificity is unmeasured.
QA blocker escalation and general service-incident escalation have different recipients; answers must preserve that scope distinction.
Authorization checks cover the returned candidates in this corpus, not a complete access-control certification.
The reported reranker metadata lacks a weight revision, so byte-identical model weights are not established.
Held-out results are now observed; use new reserved cases if tuning the policy further.
Raw corpus snapshots contain confidential and credential-looking content; keep them private and out of public demos.

validation.network: local retrieval endpoints only during capture; blocked during comparison and tests

cv_safe_wording: Implemented and benchmarked configurable RAG context pruning, reducing retrieved-text characters by 22.7% across a 14-query held-out set.
